IBEW.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Indoor Locals — Wednesday, July 29, 2026**

**LU-481 Indianapolis, IN** is running hot with **$54.75** scale across 41 calls and only 153 hands on the books—Book 1's moving. Meade Electric has 15 JW spots on the Meta Data Center Lebanon at **$53.80/hr with 10% over scale**, running 5-12's Mon-Fri plus Saturday 10-hour shifts. Ermco's pulling 17 hands for the Google Data Center Mooresville (outdoor new construction, 5-10's + Saturdays). This is the rare combo of volume, premium pay, and light competition.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** is the PLA play. Four contractors—VECA, Quality Electric, and Prime Controls—are staffing the Micron ID1 build at **$45.33/hr** with **$170/day per diem** (7 days) for eligible hands, plus VECA's got 10 JW calls on the META KND 3&5 at full **$65.33** scale with incentive OT premiums. 20 total calls, 120 hands—books are tighter than the numbers suggest.

**LU-494 Milwaukee, WI** has 41 calls and 197 hands chasing the Port Washington Data Center across four contractors (Gurtz, MJ Electric, Cupertino, Tri-City). The play: **JW scale + $10/hr base wage bump** across all shops, running 50-60 hour weeks. That's real money on a massive, sustained project.

**LU-613 Atlanta, GA** posted 43 calls, 293 hands, top scale **$48.00**. Inglett & Stubbs dominates with 67 combined JW spots at $40/hr on QTS Fayette and Wellstar Paulding Hospital, 4-10's Mon-Sat. Not high pay, but thick volume and steady hours.

**LU-237 Niagara Falls, NY** is stacked with 88 JW calls across three contractors on Lake Mariner Data Center—7/10 schedule, 6:30 AM start, per diem available. Book depth is thin (94 hands total), making dispatch quick.

**LU-1547 Anchorage, AK** shows 46 calls but only 60 hands: the math says books clear fast here, though most calls are "Other" work—still, it's the tightest ratio on the board.

**The trend:** Data centers and industrial plants are pulling all available hands; geographic arbitrage (PLA work, per diem, over-scale premiums) is the margin right now—chase the mega-projects with incentive language.

LINEMAN.text:
**Trampin the IBEW Lineman Locals — Wednesday, July 29, 2026**

**LU-71 Columbus, OH** is your heavyweight right now — 46 calls, ~140 hands deep, and NEW RIVER ELECT. CORP. is loading up: 40 JW Linemen on distribution work in Columbus itself, **$125/night per diem plus a $125 bonus on 10-hour days**, 6-10s; another 9 JW out in Southern Ohio on 4-10s with optional weekends. CAPITAL ELECTRIC is also hunting 6 JW for cable splicing in Johnstown with **$100/day per diem** and OSHA 10 required. This is the board to hit if you can move fast.

**LU-291 Boise, ID** — three separate contractors hammering Micron ID1 (Inside JW, **$45.33** but **$20/hr travel pay + $170/day per diem x7** if eligible, all PLA work). That's 61 bodies across VECA Electric, Quality Electric, and Prime Controls alone. The META Data Center calls are where the real money sits: **$65.33 flat** with an incentive program and additional OT premium. PLA jobs move smooth.

**LU-583 El Paso, TX** — 11 calls, 104 hands. Summit Line wants 36 Inside JW at **$55/hr, all OT double time**, requiring NM State JIW License EE98J. Rosendin's pushing 30 JW at **$40/hr** with a **$15 incentive for 90% of 60/hr/week**, double-time OT. Multiple contractors, multiple projects — good rotation options.

**LU-175 Chattanooga, TN** — Lawson Electric's hiring 20 Inside JW for DNN4 Data Center in Dalton, GA; hire-in Wednesday, orientation Thursday. Energy Solutions/Williams has 10 JW on the SQN & WBN TVA nuclear plants (MODS call — you'll need TVA clearance). Quick onboards.

**LU-84 Newnan, GA** — INCEPTION ENERGY SOLUTIONS wants 9 JW Linemen in Savannah at **$46.80/hr + $100/day per diem**, GRID experience required. FAIRWAY ELECTRIC's 8 JW in Columbus, same rate, onboard 8/3.

**LU-1426 Grand Forks, ND** — Hunt Electric and Parsons are stacking work: Grand Forks Air Base (Hunt, 10 calls at **$44.80 + $100/day incentive**); Polaris Forge Data Center in Harwood (Parsons, **$44.80 + $100/day M-F, $150 Sat/Sun**, non-taxed).

Data centers and military bases are where the consistent long-call work is landing — distro and backbone rebuild trails behind.

UA.text:
**Trampin the UA Locals — Wednesday, July 29, 2026**

**LU-208 Denver, CO** is cooking with 21 calls and a tight 38-hand book. US Eng. Metalworks is running night shift fitters in their shop (two spots want SS fitting experience), while Murphy's got three fitter slots at the Iron Mountain data center ramping from 5/10s to 6/10s starting Aug 5. Olson Plumbing is staffing Parker Advent Hospital with three pipefitters on 4/10s. This one's moving fast — data center work always does.

**LU-140 Salt Lake City, UT** has the board's biggest single play: 18 calls, ~61 hands, driven by BCS Mechanical's Sego Project monster in West Valley. That's 15 JM pipefitters and 13 JM plumbers both on 4/10s (6 AM–4:30 PM, OT included), kicking off Aug 3. Five apprentice slots available too. DSI's got six more JM pipefitters at QTS in Eagle Mountain on a 5-10 + one 8-hour grind. Salt Lake's the heavyweight right now.

**LU-290 Portland, OR** is Intel-heavy: 21 calls across specialized work. Charter Mechanical needs four orbital welders for tool install at Intel Ronler Acres (Ticket #71459); Harder's hiring three BIM detailers at their Portland office (Ticket #71463); PermaCold's running three commercial refrigeration techs in the metro. Niche skills, but 30 hands on a 21-call board means it's not moving slow.

**LU-776 Lima, OH** remains the dark horse: seven calls, 24 hands. Gem's fab shop wants combo welders (bennies don't pyramid — watch that). Graham and IPS both need DISA-cleared pipefitters (no beards) at Cenovus maintenance; Nooter's offering $125/day per diem plus incentive pay, rolling to Cenovus 9/9 for 7–10s out. That per diem's real money on fab and refinery work.

**LU-192 Cheyenne, WY** is shutdown season: three calls, 18 hands. MAP's got 12 welders on day shift at Holly Frontier Sinclair Refinery (DISA required); PMI's running two more slots — a combo welder at Ellsworth AFB and a plumber at Fort Meade VA Hospital, both in South Dakota with $100/day per diem and OSHA10 mandatory.

Data center and refinery work is pulling hands west and north; industrial process piping and fab shops are the only thing holding the Midwest and Canadian boards afloat.
